title: Reel 3: the length and route of the European tour
summary: Howard gives the itinerary after England and estimates six weeks in London, four in Paris and three months in total.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So where did you go after England?
Paris, Belgium, and then Germany. And we came home.
How long were you going all together?
The room was about six weeks in London, four weeks in Paris. I'm not sure. The whole thing was around three months.
